title: Simple harmonic motion: definition and graphs; Energy in SHM
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for AQA A-level Physics (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: O01-1#t4 term and clue written for the game; O01-1#t2 term and clue written for the game; O03-1#t4 term and clue written for the game; O01-uk1#t2 term and clue written for the game. Questions: O01-1#N.10a, O01-uk1#N.6, O03-1#N.1a, O01-1#N.11, O03-1#N.9a.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Amplitude
items.clue: Maximum displacement of an oscillating object.

items.label: Restoring force
items.clue: Always points back to equilibrium, opposite to the displacement.

items.label: Turning point
items.clue: Either extreme, x = +A or x = –A, where the oscillator is momentarily at rest.

items.label: Antiphase
items.clue: Relation between two oscillators of equal T that are π rad, half a cycle, apart.

questions.stem: An object in SHM has a maximum speed v_max and a maximum acceleration of magnitude a_max. Which expression gives the period T of the motion?
An object in SHM is released from rest at x = +0.060 m at time t = 0 and oscillates about x = 0 with a period of 1.2 s. What is the object's position at t = 0.20 s?
A mass on a horizontal spring moves with simple harmonic motion on a frictionless surface; air resistance is negligible. Which statement about the energy of the oscillator is correct?

options.text: At each extreme, E_k is greatest, because the acceleration of the mass is greatest there.
At each extreme, the total energy is zero, because the mass is not moving there.
At each extreme, all the energy is stored in the spring, because the mass is at rest.
The total energy falls during each cycle, because energy is used up in keeping the mass moving.

questions.stem: A pendulum bob swings to and fro in a small arc. At the lowest point of its swing, what are its acceleration along its path and its speed?

options.text: Acceleration along the path greatest; speed zero.
Acceleration along the path zero; speed greatest.
Acceleration along the path zero; speed also zero.
Acceleration along the path greatest; speed greatest.

questions.explanation: The lowest point is equilibrium: the restoring force along the path is zero there. The bob sped up all the way down and starts to slow on the way up, so its speed is greatest here.

questions.stem: A mass of 0.25 kg on a spring of spring constant 16 N m⁻¹ oscillates with simple harmonic motion of amplitude 0.050 m. What is its speed when its displacement is 0.030 m?
